answer.rationale: A release went out 2 hours ago and write-path p99 is 5x target; memory_b1 shows rollback cleared a similar spike without customer impact. Staged/canary gating (memory_b6) suggests the new build may be the regression source. Since settlement traffic is at peak and writes are heavy, I would pair the rollback with capacity/provisioning headroom (memory_b3 principle) in the next window. Regional failover (memory_b2) is a strong fallback if the rollback does not recover latency, but it is a larger blast radius for one intervention. I am not yet pulling memory_b5 or memory_b6 for verification because the rollback and capacity signals are the most load-bearing for this choice.
